calibration.note: Recalibrate against nvfortran once the HPC SDK image is available.

program_run.method: gfortran -O2 vs -O3 -ffast-math -funroll-loops, the whole program at its declared timing size (20000 tiles, 5000 steps), neither build ported
program_run.note: Two compilations of the unmodified code disagree by ~3.6e-06 after 5000 float32 steps, which is why the whole-program run cannot be judged by the single-call bands under 'variables': there the observed spread was exactly zero. Only the absolute band is widened; an element that drifts further than the compiler alone does is a failure whatever its ratio.

acceptance: A variable passes if (max_abs <= abs) OR (max_rel <= rel) OR (max_ulp <= ulp). 'variables' bands one call of the region; 'files' bands one whole-program run, per file the timing run writes.
